decision: Hold build 61 from release. The private signed candidate and its controlled tests are identifiable and functional within their measured scope. At the recorded time the first formal PR check set had two terminal native failures, while the current originating browser/desktop conditions had produced zero same-package site inputs. The repository has an independently reviewed QA-script correction; no later cloud result is assumed. This is a readiness review, with no final release or GitHub approval.

Compared the formal and independent receipts, read the executable's architecture signatures and independently reran codesign, Gatekeeper and stapler. All final OS checks exited 0. The independent install receipt records a read-only image mount, detached image, equal install tree and nine checks. I did not relaunch the installed candidate or operate the browser. historicalDatabaseVerification.scope: Three real sealed build 59 failure archives were read using standalone immutable SQLite handles. I rehashed the original source screenshot, original media and isolated PNG copy, checked integrity and foreign keys on all nine database files, compared original operations/checkpoints/START tables across v4 → 7 → 7, reran the frozen original recovery verifier on every before/after pair, and compared new renderer identities with the older build 60 bridge records. Three fresh controlled successor STARTs matched SQLite byte-for-byte evidence identifiers with one controlled input per explicit operation. These closed inputs did not contact, or recreate acceptance by, the live service.

redaction.scope: All 13 build 61 evidence files at this evidence checkpoint are JSON and parse without duplicate keys. Exact source identifiers/filenames drawn from the private historical request/receipt data were absent. Bounded detection found no raw screenshot payload, DB, personal file path, exact individual service conversation URL, signed object URL, cookie, provider token or private key. The raw captures and SQLite backups remain private. A bounded pattern/marker comparison cannot establish the absence of every possible identifying detail.

remainingConditions: For the repaired integration, obtain a new admission-only H and actual five-job results on GitHub's verified prospective [B,H] merge tree. Recheck actual main and post-merge checks when a merge is authorized.

On this exact DMG, the authorized issuer needs a normal, unlocked, non-protected foreground with its dedicated signed-in ordinary Chrome/Edge window and selected tab. Require matching native process/window/tab plus WindowServer, AX, document, original editor and attachment-entry evidence before any input.

Obtain G1/G2 on the actual installation, including cold/warm first attachments, three rapid two-image pairs per browser, and existing draft text/selection/attachments with independent event and no-send/no-submit evidence.

Obtain G4-C with an enrolled original ambiguous upload, explicit user-equivalent History confirmation/selection, independently bound new operation and persisted START. Also require qualified G4-A on the original named site error card, or original full-PNG-attributable upstream 4xx and documented card disappearance with independent equivalence adjudication for G4-B. Local controls, old historical cases and a client abort alone do not satisfy those conditions.

Public download, signed stable-feed transition, website, clean-device install and real in-app upgrade remain downstream; check them after their authorized release actions. Latest public GitHub Release in this review remained v1.0.5 and Issue #120 remained open.
